mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate indicates a robust economy, which in turn drives up demand for goods and services, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, which stimulates economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate, combined with a strong increase in payroll employment, indicates a tight labor market, which drives up wages and leads to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment and strong payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production growth rate indicates a slowdown in economic activity, which leads to lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of slow industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts indicates a robust housing market, which drives up demand for goods and services, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate, combined with a low inflation rate, signals an accommodative monetary policy, which stimulates economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate, combined with a weak increase in payroll employment, indicates a slack labor market, which drives down wages and leads to lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high unemployment and weak payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in retail sales, combined with a low unemployment rate, indicates a robust consumer sector, which drives up demand for goods and services, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong retail sales and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).
